messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts for tenant CrimsonCare on dedicated-cluster us-central-2. Detected at 2026-03-15T11:12:00Z. 504/502 spike to 7.4% (normal <0.5%). p95 latency 2.1s. Pager fired. https://observability/redwood/alerts/ALERT-9910
harshit: oncall here, grabbing it. Olivia, are customers reporting live user impact? any specific endpoints?
olivia-cs: CrimsonCare support on call, they say majority of inference requests to /v1/generate returning 502/504 since 11:11. They reported increased retry traffic which might be amplifying it.
lina.choi: quick glance - traffic concentrated on a handful of shards (kv-prefix skew). KV eviction counters for tenant_id=crimson show sharp rise. suspect noisy-tenant causing cache thrash and evictions -> higher V100 memory churn.
mike.kerr: ssh'd into gpu-07/gpu-08: noticing repeated kernel restarts and container OOMKills. logs excerpt:
```
runtime: kv_cache_evictions=1.9k/min tenant=crimson
kubelet: Pod OOMKilled: container inference-runtime (OOMKill)
proxy: upstream closed connection -> 504
```
harshit: mitigation plan: (A) apply tenant-level burst throttle (B) temporarily reroute tenant to warm spare pool (C) add capacity to spare pool and migrate sessions. Lina, can you do A+B? Mike, can you handle C and node troubleshooting?
lina.choi: applying `routing.v2` rule to set `burst=30` and `concurrency_limit=3` for tenant=crimson. Deploying canary (5%) first.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered by lina.choi: route-change `routing.v2 -> tenant=crimson burst=30 concurrency=3` (canary 5%). CI checks passed.
olivia-cs: told CrimsonCare we'll apply temporary limits and expect improvement in ~3-5 mins. they asked for logs to show progress.
harshit: also put a soft block on automated client retries via ingress header rewrite to add `Retry-After` for edge clients until stable. InfraOps please coordinate.
infra-ops: applied ingress rule to add `Retry-After: 5` to responses for tenant=crimson. also blacklisted one noisy IP seen flooding 1000r/s.
lina.choi: canary metrics: 5xx dropped from 7.4% -> 3.6% on canary shard. rolling to 50% now.
mike.kerr: spinning 3 new nodes into spare-pool-us-central. ETA ~6m for kube join and warm cache. also noticed a mis-sized PVC on pod inference-rc-41 causing local disk pressure, rotating that pod out now.
olivia-cs: CrimsonCare reports partial recovery; errors less frequent but still seeing timeouts on longer requests. asking for ETA to full recovery.
harshit: continue migration of sessions to spare pool with stateful KV transfer for active prefixes. Lina, coordinate cutover.
lina.choi: initiating stateful transfer script (safe-migrate --tenant crimson --pct 20). migration logs show transfer time ~8s per session. moving to 100% over next 4m.
deploy-bot: action: safe-migrate job started by lina.choi (job-id jm-99212).
mike.kerr: new nodes joined, warmed KV cache; started routing 1/3 traffic to spare-pool; node-level mem pressure subsided. noticed backend proxy had connection backlog, increased `worker_processes` from 8 -> 16 on edge proxies.
olivia-cs: customer confirms success on their side: 200s returned and error rate decreased. they appreciate quick mitigation.
lina.choi: migration complete. final health: 5xx 0.6%, p95 160ms. keeping watch for 30m.
harshit: opening tracking INC-9910 and assigning to eng-runtime and infra for RCA. Severity S2 due to customer-visible errors but short window.
incident-bot: Incident INC-9910 created: https://issues/redwood/INC-9910 - severity S2. Impact window estimated 11:11 - 11:22 UTC.
infra-ops: follow-ups: add alert for KV eviction_rate > 1000/min per-tenant; improve autoscaler to consider KV pressure, and add node-level metrics for GPU mem fragmentation. I'll create infra tickets.
mike.kerr: will dig into pod PVC/rotation issue and add a pre-flight sanity to prevent local disk causing pod churn.
olivia-cs: I'll send summary to CrimsonCare + post-incident note and offer a short-term SLA credit if they want it.
lina.choi: I'll draft the postmortem and include actionable mitigations: tenant burst controls default, improved migration tooling, and better per-tenant observability. taking over monitoring for remainder of shift.
harshit: thanks everyone. suppressing related alert for 45m while we validate. reopen if anything flares. :thumbsup:
